collection_semantics: Set operators compare RFC8785-JCS item bytes; order and multiplicity are ignored except NOT_UNIQUE, NOT_STRICTLY_INCREASING, COUNT_NE_PATH, and graph operators.

declared_atomic_operators.ANY_ABSENT: at least one listed path is null
declared_atomic_operators.ANY_PRESENT_STRICT_BASE64_DECODE_FAILURE: For each listed RFC6901 path in order: JSON null is skipped; a non-null value is a failure unless it is an ASCII RFC4648 standard-alphabet padded base64 string, contains no whitespace, strict decoding succeeds, and standard padded re-encoding is byte-identical to the input. The operator is true on the first failure and false when every present value passes.
declared_atomic_operators.BASE64_SHA256_NE: For a non-null base64_path that passes ANY_PRESENT_STRICT_BASE64_DECODE_FAILURE, strict-decode the exact string and compare SHA256_UPPER(decoded bytes) to digest_path; otherwise evaluator error because malformed/absence precedence must already have resolved the request
declared_atomic_operators.EQ: path/left equals literal value or right path by JSON equality
declared_atomic_operators.INTERSECTS: array sets have at least one common item
declared_atomic_operators.MEMBER: value at value_path is in collection_path
declared_atomic_operators.MEMBER_VALUE: scalar at path is in literal values
declared_atomic_operators.NOT_ACYCLIC: the directed edge graph contains a cycle
declared_atomic_operators.NOT_ALL_EQUAL_PATH: at least one collection item differs from the scalar at value_path
declared_atomic_operators.NOT_BOOLEAN_EQ_ENUM: boolean is not exactly equivalent to enum_path == true_value
declared_atomic_operators.NOT_CONTAINS_ALL: the array set omits at least one literal value
declared_atomic_operators.NOT_FUNCTIONAL_BY: two objects have equal key fields and unequal value fields
declared_atomic_operators.NOT_MEMBER_BY_KEY: the scalar at value_path is absent from every collection object's named key field
declared_atomic_operators.NOT_MEMBER_VALUE: literal value is not in collection_path
declared_atomic_operators.NOT_NEXT_SEQUENCE: prior is null and current differs from initial, or prior is non-null and current differs from prior+1
declared_atomic_operators.NOT_PAIRWISE_DISTINCT_NON_NULL: at least two non-null listed path values are JSON-equal
declared_atomic_operators.NOT_STRICTLY_INCREASING: the integer array is empty or some item is less than or equal to its predecessor
declared_atomic_operators.NOT_SUBSET: at least one left array item is absent from the right array set
declared_atomic_operators.NOT_SUBSET_VALUES: path array set is not subset of literal values
declared_atomic_operators.NOT_UNIQUE: at least two array items have identical RFC8785-JCS bytes
declared_atomic_operators.NO_EARLIER_CLASS_MATCH: true only when the three earlier predicates for the same operation are false

findings: Every operator used by the 0.2 decision table is declared in predicate_language.atomic_operators; there is no undeclared usage.
The node grammar admits four combinator forms (all, any, not, op). The 0.2 table uses all and any; not is language-admitted and previously unused.
NO_EARLIER_CLASS_MATCH appears exactly once per operation as the VALID predicate, by construction.
node_forms: A predicate is exactly one object containing one of all, any, not, or op.
all and any evaluate their nonempty child arrays left-to-right without side effects; not negates one child; op is one frozen atomic operator.
path_resolution: Every path is an RFC6901 pointer into decision_input. Missing path is an evaluator error; nullable fields use JSON null and are tested by ABSENT/PRESENT.
purpose: Mechanical census of the frozen predicate vocabulary of the accepted 0.2 semantic decision contract, produced as the authoring basis for the supplemental 0.3 rows. Row predicates for the 0.3 generation must be designed inside this vocabulary; a new atomic operator is admissible only where discrimination would otherwise be vacuous, and none was required.

first_use_of_language_admitted_not_combi: OBL-29 MALFORMED_OR_BOUNDARY: cost-exceeds-budget via not(LE(asked_query_cost, budget_remaining))
supplemental_0_3_usage_plan.rationale: Both supplemental rows are expressible with the frozen atomic operators plus the language-admitted combinators. The caller-derived-fact style of OBL-22 (verdict and projection fields attested by the caller, with structural coherence predicates over them) carries the joins the atomic vocabulary cannot express.
